description: A Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) server for Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform: Playwright (connectOverCDP), Puppeteer and the other CDP clients automate the managed browser engine as a Chromium browser.

CLI that runs a Chrome DevTools Protocol server whose browser is Meziantou.Framework.WebPlatform: Playwright (connectOverCDP), Puppeteer and the other CDP clients connect to it as to a headless Chromium

Plays YouTube videos inside .NET MAUI hybrid apps (BlazorWebView, HybridWebView) without YouTube's Error 153 on iOS and Mac Catalyst, and without a proxy page on your own domain. Everywhere else it hands out YouTube's own embed URL, so a Razor library shared with a website references it too.
SpiceDB-style schema language for Loom: lexer, parser, and AST for definitions, relations, and permissions.
Framework-agnostic assertion helpers for Loom -- ShouldPermitAsync/ShouldDenyAsync/ShouldRequireCaveatContextAsync, no host or DI required.
Mutable relation-tuple storage for Loom: read/write/delete and namespace enumeration, backed by a pluggable store abstraction.
The Check algorithm: resolves a Loom schema's permission rewrite tree against stored relation tuples.
A CEL-subset expression engine for Loom caveats: parameterized ABAC conditions attached to relation tuples, in the style of Netflix's ABAC-on-SpiceDB pattern.
SQL Server-backed relation-tuple and schema storage for Loom, with configurable table/column mapping -- the thread store that feeds the loom.
ASP.NET Core DI integration for Loom -- services.AddLoom(...) registration and an IAuthorizationHandler for declarative policy-based checks.
AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0-compatible HTTP endpoint (MapAuthZenEndpoints) in front of a LoomEvaluator.
Core value types for Loom: ObjectRef, SubjectRef, RelationTuple, and CheckResult.
